messages:
Priya N: Paging note — PagerBot fired at 06:12 UTC for high tail latency on runtime-proxy (eu-west). 5xx spikes and long TTFB observed by customers. Triggered automated incident creation.
Oncall Bot: Incident logged: INC-2026-0501. Alert: tail_latency_99p > 1.2s on runtime-proxy (eu-west)

Liam R: Thanks Priya. Can you dump the immediate checks (pods, cpu/mem, recent deploys)?

Priya N: Quick checks:
- No recent full-service deploys in last 6h; a scheduled canary deploy rolled at 02:30 but marked green.
- Pods: runtime-proxy-0..3 all present, two pods at high CPU (90%+), one OOMKilled in the last hour (restarted)
- Autoscaler had scaled to 4 but didn't kick to 6 because cpu threshold was 95%

Sam T: Noted the OOM in pod runtime-proxy-2 — pulling logs now. If kernel fallback engaged it could explain heavy CPU on tokenization path.

Support Bot: Affected customers: ENT-3201, ENT-3204 — support cases created SUP-10021, SUP-10022. Temporary mitigation note: route to us-central if acceptable for latency.

Priya N: Immediate mitigation performed at 06:18 UTC:
```
kubectl set resources deploy/runtime-proxy -n inference-eu --limits=cpu=2000m,memory=4Gi --requests=cpu=800m,memory=2Gi
kubectl rollout restart deploy/runtime-proxy -n inference-eu
kubectl annotate deploy/runtime-proxy redwood/incident-mitigated=true -n inference-eu
```
Also bumped HPA maxReplicas=8 and changed target CPU utilization to 60% to be more aggressive.

Liam R: Good. Did restarts clear the backlog?

Priya N: Metrics: request queue depth dropped ~06:23 UTC, p99 latency down by ~700ms. No more 5xx after 06:25. Marking incident as STABILIZING.

Oncall Bot: Incident INC-2026-0501 status: STABILIZING (updated by Priya N at 06:26 UTC)

Sam T: Root cause hypothesis: memory leak in token-buffer path triggered by a rare input pattern from a customer A/B experiment hitting a fallback codec path. Canary didn't catch it because synthetic inputs didn't include the pattern.

Priya N: For the next shift: Primary = Liam R (06:45–14:45 UTC), Secondary = Sam T. Coverage gap flagged 02:00–03:00 UTC overlap with APAC rotation earlier — create a watchlist for next week.

Liam R: I'll take primary. Sam can you prepare a short repro harness for the token-buffer issue? Put it under infra/bench/token-fallback so we can run in CI.

Sam T: On it. I'll add a canary-smoke job that includes the rare input fuzz cases. Will open a PR and assign to Priya for review.

Support Bot: Customer communication: initial outreach sent to ENT-3201/3204. Routing workaround offered; both accepted temporary routing to US region.

Priya N: Filed follow-up ticket RED-4621 for RCA and long-term fixes (link: https://issues.redwood/RED-4621). I've scheduled a postmortem meeting for 2026-05-03 15:00 UTC; invite includes eng-oncall, eng-runtime, QA, product-ops.

Liam R: Action items during handoff:
- Priya N: Add exact mitigation commands and HPA tuning to runbook section "runtime-proxy scale" (due 2026-05-02).
- Sam T: Draft repro and CI canary smoke test (due 2026-05-01).
- Liam R: Own RCA doc and link metrics/graphs (due 2026-05-02).
- QA Bot: Add a regression test to prevent this input-case from reaching canary (follow-up ticket created).

QA Bot: Regression ticket QRG-77 created and linked to RED-4621. Suggest adding puppet job `smoke/token-fallback` to nightly.
Priya N: Note on handoff: I'll be available for questions until 07:10 UTC. Please escalate to eng-sre if latency returns above 900ms p99 for 10m.

Liam R: I'll kick off the RCA draft and collect dashboards — dashboards saved under eng-runtime/dashboards/runtime-proxy/2026-05-01-spike. Also copying timeline to the postmortem doc.

Oncall Bot: Incident INC-2026-0501 marked RESOLVED-STABLE by Liam R at 06:40 UTC — monitor for 12h.

Sam T: One more note: recommend lowering HPA target to 55% in canary env to surface situations earlier. I'll add that to the PR.

Priya N: Thanks everyone for quick responses. Handoff complete — Liam primary confirmed. If anything pops up, ping @Liam R directly. :handshake:
